description: This file defines the "ExceptionHandler" class within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation namespace, responsible for registering and unregistering a custom error handler.

classes.name: ExceptionHandler
classes.description: Manages registration and deregistration of a custom PHP error handler for calculation errors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Registers a custom error handler callback for all error types.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Restores the previous PHP error handler.
